channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Inciter Art (Fractured Atlas): quarterly open call for essays, 'tending to the hearth' (USD 750 stipend)
item.description: Fractured Atlas (Inciter Art) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 750 stipend per selected writer, paid by ACH deposit or check once the first draft is finished (a W-9 form is required). No submission fee.

item.title: VIA Art Fund: Artistic Production Grant (Spring 2027 cycle)
item.description: VIA Art Fund · deadline 05 Nov 2026 · $25,000 to $100,000 per project

item.title: Busan Metropolitan City: Open Call for Land / Ecological Art on Eulsukdo
item.description: Busan Metropolitan City, Urban Parks Division · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · One proposal selected. Artwork support KRW 380,000,000 (approx. EUR 235,000) plus artist fee KRW 20,000,000 (approx. EUR 12,500). No entry fee indicated.

item.title: Kulturstiftung des Bundes: General Project Funding, January 2027 round (Allgemeine Projektfoerderung)
item.description: Kulturstiftung des Bundes (German Federal Cultural Foundation) · deadline 31 Jan 2027 · No fixed ceiling, but total project costs must exceed EUR 50,000 to be eligible. The Foundation allocates up to EUR 10 million per year across this line. At least 20 percent of total project costs must be secured from own capital and/or third-party funding. No application fee.

item.title: Bertha Artivism Awards 2027
item.description: Bertha Foundation · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to USD 20,000 per one-year activist-art project. Free to apply.

item.title: Swarovski Foundation: Creatives for Our Future 2026/27 (Global Grant for Emerging Creatives)
item.description: Swarovski Foundation · deadline 09 Nov 2026 · EUR 20,000 grant per selected participant, plus a mentorship and education programme. No application fee.
